movie_title: Michelle Obama and her mission to inspire women - 6 Minute English
introduction: Improve your English vocabulary and speaking with 6 Minute English! Michelle Obama left the White Ho

vocabulary.definition: a psychological pattern in which an individual doubts their accomplishments and has a persistent internalized fear of being exposed as a fraud
vocabulary.example: She struggled with imposter syndrome, always feeling like she didn't deserve the recognition she received.

vocabulary.definition: the process of giving people the authority or power to do something; making individuals more confident in their abilities
vocabulary.example: The organization focuses on empowerment through education, helping individuals realize their full potential.

vocabulary.definition: to fill someone with the urge or ability to do or feel something, especially to do something creative
vocabulary.example: Her story inspired many young students to pursue careers in science.

vocabulary.definition: to take for granted without proof; to suppose to be the case, without proof
vocabulary.example: Do not assume that everyone shares the same opinions as you do.

vocabulary.definition: based on their personal skills or abilities, rather than external factors or associations
vocabulary.example: She is an accomplished artist in her own right, regardless of her family background.

vocabulary.definition: one's social position or status in society
vocabulary.example: Despite his humble station in life, he worked hard to achieve success in his career.
